hypothesis: Use round margin in rounds 0 and 1, then the checkpoint-consistent hybrid match return in round 2, without changing shortlist size or rollout compute.

development.use: runtime, parser, determinism and operational sanity only; excluded from efficacy evidence

design.combination: Invert the second block to the candidate perspective, then equal-weight the two independent reciprocal blocks. Combined SE is sqrt(SE1^2 + SE2^2) / 2.

promotion_gate.primary: combined candidate match score minus 1.645 standard errors must exceed 0.5
promotion_gate.orientation_check: candidate match-score point estimate must exceed 0.5 in each reciprocal block after inversion
secondary: report combined point margin and uncertainty
reject operational errors, unfinished continuations, or configuration drift
